name: agentic-advisor
description: Before writing code, grades how fragile the target is from LinearB health signals + local git history (rework, incidents, fix/revert density, code ownership) and holds the agent to a matching effort level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH) — lean on calm repos, defensive on fragile ones. Auto-triggers via a bundled hook and can report each effort decision to your LinearB org as usage telemetry.
